ext.displayName: TurtleGit - TortoiseGit-style Git UI for VSCode
ext.description: Brings TortoiseGit's commit / browse / diff experience to VSCode: floating dialogs, revision graph, per-hunk commit. Pure extension - no TortoiseGit required, works on Linux, macOS and Windows.

cfg.language.description: UI language. "auto" follows the VSCode display language (a Chinese / Traditional Chinese language pack switches it automatically); other languages fall back to English.
cfg.language.auto: auto: follow the VSCode display language
cfg.gitPath.description: Path to the git executable. Leave empty to auto-detect (PATH, TortoiseGit's bundled git, Git for Windows).
cfg.panelMode.auto: auto: floating window first, fall back to an editor tab when unavailable
cfg.panelMode.floating: floating: move dialogs to a separate OS window (closest to TortoiseGit)
cfg.panelMode.embedded: embedded: always open as an editor tab (most stable)
cfg.autoRefresh.description: Auto-refresh dialog contents when the repository changes.
cfg.showStatusDecorations.description: Show file status badges in the explorer (TortoiseGit-style icon overlay).
cfg.ignoredExcludeDirs.description: Folders hidden when "Ignored" is checked. Matched by directory name or repo-relative path (e.g. .history, node_modules, dist/build); name matching applies at any depth. Empty array = show everything.
